obligations.title: Add the duty: Analyse integrity risks systematically and turn the integrity policy into procedures and measures
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit prudentiële regels Wft, BWBR0020420, art. 10, text in force from 2026-10-16; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020420&artikel=10

titles.en: Analyse integrity risks systematically and turn the integrity policy into procedures and measures

summaries.en: A bank, payment institution, e-money institution and the other firms the article lists must analyse its integrity risks systematically and translate its integrity policy into procedures and measures that all relevant business units know. It must carry out and test the policy systematically, have its execution monitored independently, and make sure that shortcomings are reported to the compliance function and lead to adjustment under its supervision.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Counter conflicts of private interests and control financial services on staff terms to policymakers
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit prudentiële regels Wft, BWBR0020420, art. 11 lid 1 tot en met 4, text in force from 2026-10-16; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020420&artikel=11

titles.en: Counter conflicts of private interests and control financial services on staff terms to policymakers

summaries.en: A bank and the other firms the article lists must have procedures and measures that counter the entanglement of the private interests of its policymakers, group directors, supervisory body members and staff with its own interests or those of its clients. A bank must also have procedures for financial services on staff terms to its policymakers and group directors; such services are given only in the normal course of business and each time with the approval of the supervisory body, and services outside the staff scheme only on the usual commercial terms and security.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Handle and record incidents, act on them and tell De Nederlandsche Bank without delay
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit prudentiële regels Wft, BWBR0020420, art. 12, text in force from 2026-10-16; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020420&artikel=12

titles.en: Handle and record incidents, act on them and tell De Nederlandsche Bank without delay

summaries.en: A bank and the other firms the article lists must have procedures and measures for dealing with incidents and recording them. After an incident it must take measures to control the risks that arose and to prevent a repeat, and it must inform De Nederlandsche Bank about incidents without delay.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Accept, identify, classify and monitor clients under documented procedures and keep the records for five years
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit prudentiële regels Wft, BWBR0020420, art. 14 lid 1 tot en met 5, text in force from 2026-10-16; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020420&artikel=14

titles.en: Accept, identify, classify and monitor clients under documented procedures and keep the records for five years

summaries.en: A bank, life insurer or premium pension institution must have procedures and measures for accepting clients and, beside the anti-money laundering act, for establishing and verifying their identity; a bank or life insurer does not accept a client whose identity has not been established under its policy. It must classify clients, products and services by risk, analyse client data to detect unusual transaction patterns, and document client acceptance, risk classification, identification and monitoring, keeping those records for five years after the service or the end of the relationship.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Organise the business clearly and have its effectiveness reviewed independently at least once a year
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit prudentiële regels Wft, BWBR0020420, art. 17 lid 1 tot en met 4, text in force from 2026-10-16; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020420&artikel=17

titles.en: Organise the business clearly and have its effectiveness reviewed independently at least once a year

summaries.en: A bank, payment institution, e-money institution and the other firms the article lists must have a clear, balanced and adequate organisational structure and division of tasks and responsibilities, adequate recording of rights and obligations, unambiguous reporting lines and an adequate information and communication system, suited to the nature, size, risks and complexity of its work and recorded transparently. An internal control unit must test the effectiveness of the organisation and of its procedures and measures independently at least once a year, and the firm must remedy the shortcomings found.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep an independent and effective compliance function
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit prudentiële regels Wft, BWBR0020420, art. 21 lid 1 tot en met 3, text in force from 2026-10-16; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020420&artikel=21

titles.en: Keep an independent and effective compliance function

summaries.en: A bank, payment institution, e-money institution and the other firms the article lists must have a unit that performs a compliance function independently and effectively, checking compliance with the law and with the firm's own internal rules. For a bank allowed to provide investment services in the Netherlands the unit also advises the staff concerned, monitors the internal rules and procedures, assesses the measures taken against shortcomings, reports at least once a year to management and any supervisory body, and has the authority, resources, expertise and access to information it needs.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep the data needed for the safety net schemes current and supply them on request
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit prudentiële regels Wft, BWBR0020420, art. 26a, text in force from 2026-10-16; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020420&artikel=26a

titles.en: Keep the data needed for the safety net schemes current and supply them on request

summaries.en: A bank, investment firm or financial institution with a declaration of supervision must have procedures and measures that keep the data needed to carry out the safety net schemes up to date and properly recorded at all times. It must supply those data to De Nederlandsche Bank on request, within the period and in the manner the Bank sets.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Govern structural outsourcing with a policy, the means to assess the provider and a written contract with the required terms
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit prudentiële regels Wft, BWBR0020420, art. 29 lid 1, art. 30, art. 31 lid 1 en 2 en art. 32, text in force from 2026-10-16; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020420&artikel=29

titles.en: Govern structural outsourcing with a policy, the means to assess the provider and a written contract with the required terms

summaries.en: A bank, payment institution, e-money institution and the other firms the article lists must pursue an adequate policy, with procedures and measures, for outsourcing work on a structural basis, and must have the procedures, measures, expertise and information to assess how the outsourced work is carried out. It must record the agreement with the provider in writing, covering at least the exchange of information including what the supervisors ask for, its right to change how the work is done, the provider's duty to enable continued compliance with the act, on-site inspection by the supervisors, and how the contract ends and the work returns in house or moves to another provider. Outsourcing to group companies in a member state is exempt, except for banks, payment and e-money institutions and premium pension institutions.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Develop and review financial products in a documented process that weighs the client's interests
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit Gedragstoezicht financiële ondernemingen Wft, BWBR0020421, art. 32 lid 1 tot en met 4, text in force from 2026-10-30; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020421&artikel=32

titles.en: Develop and review financial products in a documented process that weighs the client's interests

summaries.en: A financial undertaking that offers or designs financial products and makes them available must have recorded procedures and measures ensuring that a product's development balances the interests of consumers, clients and beneficiaries and demonstrably results from that weighing: it defines the target group and its objective, tests how the product works in different scenarios, aligns product information and, as far as can be expected, distribution with the target group, and checks and adjusts the procedures regularly. It applies them periodically to its existing products and, where a product harms the interests of those it was developed for, changes the product or stops offering it as soon as possible, subject to the exceptions the article lists.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give the standard cost information and the warning in credit advertising and avoid the forbidden claims
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit Gedragstoezicht financiële ondernemingen Wft, BWBR0020421, art. 53 lid 1 tot en met 4, 7 en 9, text in force from 2026-10-30; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020421&artikel=53

titles.en: Give the standard cost information and the warning in credit advertising and avoid the forbidden claims

summaries.en: A financial undertaking that mentions a borrowing rate or other cost figures in credit advertising must also give the rate and other costs, the total amount of credit, the annual percentage rate of charge, its identity and address and, where relevant, the duration, total amount payable, number and amount of instalments and, for mortgage credit, the security, in a separate table outside television and radio and based on credit representative of what it actually grants. Credit advertising must carry a warning about the consequences of credit, unless it is mortgage advertising tied only to buying one's own home, and may not stress the ease or speed of credit, suggest that existing credit or a negative credit register check does not matter, or present tax advantages as features of the credit.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Hold documented information on the consumer's finances and check the credit register before lending
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit Gedragstoezicht financiële ondernemingen Wft, BWBR0020421, art. 113 lid 1 en art. 114, text in force from 2026-10-30; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020421&artikel=113

titles.en: Hold documented information on the consumer's finances and check the credit register before lending

summaries.en: A credit provider may not conclude a credit agreement with a consumer for a total amount above 1,000 euros unless it holds enough information on the consumer's financial position, recorded in writing or on another durable medium, to judge whether the agreement is responsible and avoids overindebtedness; credit secured on listed or publicly priced securities the consumer already holds, within set loan-to-value limits, and short overdrafts are exempt. Before concluding a credit agreement above 250 euros it must consult the data on the consumer's existing credit registered in the credit registration system it takes part in.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Record and apply lending criteria and, for mortgages, the ministerial income and loan-to-value norms
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit Gedragstoezicht financiële ondernemingen Wft, BWBR0020421, art. 115 lid 1, 2, 4, 5 en 6, text in force from 2026-10-30; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020421&artikel=115

titles.en: Record and apply lending criteria and, for mortgages, the ministerial income and loan-to-value norms

summaries.en: To prevent overindebtedness a credit provider must record the criteria on which it assesses a consumer's credit application and apply them, except for short overdrafts repaid within three months. A mortgage lender must in addition apply the income criteria set by ministerial regulation and take account of the maximum mortgage credit in relation to the value of the home set by that regulation, the value being established in one of the ways the article lists.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Use clients' electronic contact details for distance marketing only with a free right to object and identify the sender
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit Gedragstoezicht financiële ondernemingen Wft, BWBR0020421, art. 81 lid 1 en 2, text in force from 2026-10-30; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020421&artikel=81

titles.en: Use clients' electronic contact details for distance marketing only with a free right to object and identify the sender

summaries.en: A financial undertaking that obtained a consumer's electronic contact details when selling a financial product or service may use them to promote its own similar products or services at a distance only if the consumer was clearly given the chance, free of charge and easily, to object under Article 21 of the GDPR when the details were collected, and is given the same chance in every later message. Each such message must show the real identity of the sender on whose behalf it is sent and a valid address or number to which the recipient can send a request to stop the messages.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Run a described complaints procedure, keep a complaints register and answer within the set periods
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit Gedragstoezicht financiële ondernemingen Wft, BWBR0020421, art. 39 tot en met 43, text in force from 2026-10-30; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020421&artikel=39

titles.en: Run a described complaints procedure, keep a complaints register and answer within the set periods

summaries.en: A financial undertaking, other than an investment firm covered by the act's own complaints rule, must give everyone involved in handling complaints a description of the procedure and keep a register recording at least the complainant's name and address, the complaint with its date of receipt and how it was handled, kept for at least one year after the complaint was settled. It must confirm receipt, tell the complainant within two weeks when the complaint will be dealt with and settle it within a reasonable time, and on a whole or partial rejection point out the designated dispute resolution body with its time limits and the option of going to court; the timing rules do not apply to payment service providers.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Neither pay nor receive commission for advice or mediation on mortgage credit, complex products and the other listed products
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit Gedragstoezicht financiële ondernemingen Wft, BWBR0020421, art. 86c lid 1 tot en met 3, text in force from 2026-10-30; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020421&artikel=86c

titles.en: Neither pay nor receive commission for advice or mediation on mortgage credit, complex products and the other listed products

summaries.en: A financial service provider may not pay or receive, directly or indirectly, commission for mediating or advising on a payment protection product, complex product, mortgage credit, individual disability insurance, term life insurance, premium pension claim, funeral insurance or another product designated by ministerial regulation. The ban does not reach, among others, fees paid directly by the consumer or client unless clearly unreasonable, commission needed to provide the service, payments between intermediaries other than by a provider, and business gifts worth at most 100 euros a year; a commission paid by the contributing employer on a premium pension claim must be disclosed before the service.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give a comparison card on the service before advising or mediating on the listed products and publish it online
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit Gedragstoezicht financiële ondernemingen Wft, BWBR0020421, art. 86f lid 1, 2, 5 en 6, text in force from 2026-10-30; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020421&artikel=86f

titles.en: Give a comparison card on the service before advising or mediating on the listed products and publish it online

summaries.en: Before providing a financial service on a product listed in art. 86c, the financial service provider that the consumer or client approached must give a comparison card on the service asked for, stating among other things whether it advises and on an independent basis, whether it is tied to certain providers, whether it advises only on its own products, any qualifying holdings between it and a provider, and its average fees or, for a provider, its average costs for advice and distribution. If it has a website it must publish the card there.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Inform depositors about the deposit guarantee scheme as the deposit guarantee directive requires
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit bijzondere prudentiële maatregelen, beleggerscompensatie en depositogarantie Wft, BWBR0020414, art. 29.03 lid 1 en 2, text in force from 2026-07-24; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020414&artikel=29.03

titles.en: Inform depositors about the deposit guarantee scheme as the deposit guarantee directive requires

summaries.en: A bank must give depositors the information on the deposit guarantee scheme that applies to them which Article 16 of the deposit guarantee schemes directive prescribes, in the way that article sets out. Before concluding an agreement on a home-ownership bank savings deposit it must tell the holder that the deposit will be set off against the linked home loan when the scheme is applied.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Pay the quarterly contribution to the Deposit Guarantee Fund while the fund is below its target
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit bijzondere prudentiële maatregelen, beleggerscompensatie en depositogarantie Wft, BWBR0020414, art. 29.12 lid 1 tot en met 4, text in force from 2026-07-24; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020414&artikel=29.12

titles.en: Pay the quarterly contribution to the Deposit Guarantee Fund while the fund is below its target

summaries.en: A bank covered by the deposit guarantee scheme owes the Deposit Guarantee Fund a contribution every quarter as long as its individual balance or the general part of the fund is below its target size. The contribution is based on the bank's covered deposits, is set by De Nederlandsche Bank and consists of a base contribution, a supplement, a risk contribution and a risk supplement, the last two depending on the bank's risk weighting.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Pay extraordinary contributions when the Deposit Guarantee Fund lacks the means for a payout
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit bijzondere prudentiële maatregelen, beleggerscompensatie en depositogarantie Wft, BWBR0020414, art. 29.14 lid 1 tot en met 3, text in force from 2026-07-24; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020414&artikel=29.14

titles.en: Pay extraordinary contributions when the Deposit Guarantee Fund lacks the means for a payout

summaries.en: When the Deposit Guarantee Fund lacks the means to pay compensation after the scheme has been triggered, or to pay the amount the act makes available from the scheme, the banks covered by the scheme at that moment must pay extraordinary contributions. De Nederlandsche Bank sets their amount and payment terms within the limit of the deposit guarantee schemes directive and may defer a bank's payment where its solvency or liquidity warrants it.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Notify De Nederlandsche Bank six months before moving covered deposits to a bank in another member state
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit bijzondere prudentiële maatregelen, beleggerscompensatie en depositogarantie Wft, BWBR0020414, art. 29.20 lid 2, text in force from 2026-07-24; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0020414&artikel=29.20

titles.en: Notify De Nederlandsche Bank six months before moving covered deposits to a bank in another member state

summaries.en: A bank whose covered deposits will, through a relocation of its business, be held by a bank with its seat in another member state must notify De Nederlandsche Bank in writing of that intention at least six months before the planned relocation.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Treat holders of the listed prominent public functions as politically exposed persons
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Uitvoeringsbesluit Wwft 2018, BWBR0041193, art. 2 lid 1 en 2, text in force from 2026-04-30; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0041193&artikel=2

titles.en: Treat holders of the listed prominent public functions as politically exposed persons

summaries.en: For the act's rules on politically exposed persons, prominent public functions include at least: head of state, head of government, minister, deputy minister or state secretary; member of parliament or a similar legislative body; member of a political party's board; member of a supreme or constitutional court or another high court whose rulings are not normally open to appeal; member of a court of audit or of a central bank's board; ambassador, chargé d'affaires or high-ranking officer of the armed forces; member of the management, supervisory or administrative body of a state-owned enterprise; and director, deputy director or board member of an international organisation. Middle-ranking and junior officials do not hold such functions.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Treat the listed family members and close associates of a politically exposed person as such
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Uitvoeringsbesluit Wwft 2018, BWBR0041193, art. 2 lid 3 en 4, text in force from 2026-04-30; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0041193&artikel=2

titles.en: Treat the listed family members and close associates of a politically exposed person as such

summaries.en: The family members of a politically exposed person are the spouse or an equivalent partner, a child and the child's spouse or equivalent partner, and the parents. Known close associates are a natural person known to be a joint beneficial owner of a legal entity or arrangement with the politically exposed person or to have other close business relations with that person, and the sole beneficial owner of a legal entity or arrangement known to have been set up for that person's actual benefit.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Identify as beneficial owners at least the natural persons in the categories set for each type of entity
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Uitvoeringsbesluit Wwft 2018, BWBR0041193, art. 3 lid 1, 5 en 6, text in force from 2026-04-30; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0041193&artikel=3

titles.en: Identify as beneficial owners at least the natural persons in the categories set for each type of entity

summaries.en: For a private or public limited company that is not a listed issuer, the beneficial owners include at least the natural persons who ultimately own or control it through more than 25 per cent of the shares, voting rights or ownership interest or by other means such as the consolidation criteria, and similar ownership and control tests apply to associations, foundations and other legal persons and to partnerships; if after exhausting all possible means and without grounds for suspicion no such person is found, or there is doubt, the statutory directors or, in a partnership, the partners count as beneficial owners. For a trust the settlors, the trustees, any protectors, the beneficiaries or the class of beneficiaries and anyone else with ultimate control all count, and the same applies to similar arrangements.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report the transactions that meet the indicators set for the institution's type
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Uitvoeringsbesluit Wwft 2018, BWBR0041193, art. 4 en bijlage 1, text in force from 2026-04-30; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0041193&artikel=4

titles.en: Report the transactions that meet the indicators set for the institution's type

summaries.en: The indicators for the duty to report unusual transactions are set per type of institution in Annex 1, and a Dutch branch of a foreign bank or other financial undertaking applies those for its own type. For a bank they are a transaction the institution has reason to think may be linked to money laundering or terrorist financing, a cash exchange into another currency or from small to large notes of 10,000 euros or more, a cash deposit of 10,000 euros or more onto a credit or prepaid card, the use of such a card for a transaction of 15,000 euros or more, and a money transfer of 2,000 euros or more unless its settlement is left to another institution with the same reporting duty.

obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit melding transacties financiering terrorisme, BWBR0014119, art. 2 en art. 3, text in force from 2017-07-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0014119&artikel=2

titles.en: Report to the FIU every request for a financial service that involves a person or entity on the terrorism lists

summaries.en: A bank, insurer, investment fund, investment firm, insurance intermediary or other financial undertaking the decree lists must report to the Financial Intelligence Unit every request to provide a financial service in which a natural or legal person, group or entity on the lists the decree names is the counterparty or is otherwise involved. The report states, as far as possible, the identity of the requester and of the person for whom the service was requested, the nature, time and place of the service, and the size and origin of the money, securities, precious metals or other assets involved.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Answer the FIU's follow-up questions on a report within the period it sets
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit melding transacties financiering terrorisme, BWBR0014119, art. 4 lid 2, text in force from 2017-07-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0014119&artikel=4

titles.en: Answer the FIU's follow-up questions on a report within the period it sets

summaries.en: An institution that made a report, or that was involved in crediting or debiting an account in a transaction on which the Financial Intelligence Unit gathered data, must give the unit the further data or information it asks for, in writing and in urgent cases orally, within the period the unit sets.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep a report on terrorist financing secret
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit melding transacties financiering terrorisme, BWBR0014119, art. 5, text in force from 2017-07-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0014119&artikel=5

titles.en: Keep a report on terrorist financing secret

summaries.en: Whoever makes a report under the decree must keep it secret, without prejudice to the Sanctions Act 1977's rule on supplying data, except as far as disclosure is needed for the decree's purpose.

instruments.title: Add Besluit kredietvergoeding, the Dutch decree on the highest permitted charges for consumer credit
instruments.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit kredietvergoeding, BWBR0005233, royal decree made under arts. 35, 50 lid 3 and 64 of the Wet op het consumentenkrediet (preamble); art. 1a now says it rests on art. 7:76 lid 2 of the Burgerlijk Wetboek; first published in Stb. 1991, 549; consolidated text in force from 2024-07-01, read in its XML file; entry into force on 1992-01-01 read in the file's source data for the title, which name Stb. 1991, 635

titles.nl: Besluit van 16 oktober 1991, houdende regels ter uitvoering van artikel 35 van de Wet op het consumentenkrediet
titles.en: Credit Charges Decree

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep consumer credit charges within the permitted maximum of the statutory interest rate plus 8 percentage points
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit kredietvergoeding, BWBR0005233, art. 4, art. 16 en art. 16a lid 1, text in force from 2024-07-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0005233&artikel=4

titles.en: Keep consumer credit charges within the permitted maximum of the statutory interest rate plus 8 percentage points

summaries.en: The highest permitted effective annual credit charge on consumer credit is the statutory interest rate plus 8 percentage points, and the decree gives formulas for the highest permitted charge per payment period, per day or in total for each type of agreement; for a fixed charge the statutory rate in force when the agreement was made applies and for a variable charge the rate in force when the charge was last changed. The formulas do not apply where the annual percentage rate of charge is itself no higher than the statutory interest rate plus 8 percentage points.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Charge the credit fee for a period only after that period has ended
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit kredietvergoeding, BWBR0005233, art. 3, text in force from 2024-07-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0005233&artikel=3

titles.en: Charge the credit fee for a period only after that period has ended

summaries.en: A credit provider may not charge the credit fee over a given period before the last day of that period has passed.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Calculate late payment charges per day at no more than the agreed annual rate
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit kredietvergoeding, BWBR0005233, art. 11, text in force from 2024-07-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0005233&artikel=11

titles.en: Calculate late payment charges per day at no more than the agreed annual rate

summaries.en: The highest permitted charge for late payment is calculated per day on the amount in arrears or, for a revolving credit, on the part of the balance above the credit limit caused by arrears, using the effective annual credit charge agreed in the credit agreement.

titles.en: Decree on Identification and Reporting Requirements under the Common Reporting Standard

obligations.title: Add the duty: Obtain a self-certification when an individual opens a new account and renew it when circumstances change
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Uitvoeringsbesluit identificatie- en rapportagevoorschriften Common Reporting Standard, BWBR0037469, art. 5 lid 1 tot en met 4 en art. 3 lid 1, text in force from 2025-12-12; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0037469&artikel=5

titles.en: Obtain a self-certification when an individual opens a new account and renew it when circumstances change

summaries.en: A reporting financial institution must obtain a self-certification from the account holder when a natural person opens a new account, following Annex I, Section IV, part A of the Directive on administrative cooperation in taxation, and treat the account as reportable if it shows a reportable person; a self-certification is dated and signed and states at least name, address, state of tax residence, tax identification number and date of birth. If a change in circumstances gives reason to know the last self-certification is wrong or unreliable, the institution must obtain a new one or a reasonable explanation and may rely on the earlier residence for at most 90 days, after which it treats the holder as resident of both jurisdictions until it has one.

payload.refLabel: art. 5 lid 1 tot en met 4 en art. 3 lid 1

obligations.title: Add the duty: Review pre-existing individual accounts with the lower-value and high-value procedures
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Uitvoeringsbesluit identificatie- en rapportagevoorschriften Common Reporting Standard, BWBR0037469, art. 4 lid 1 tot en met 5 en art. 2 lid 1, text in force from 2025-12-12; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0037469&artikel=4

titles.en: Review pre-existing individual accounts with the lower-value and high-value procedures

summaries.en: For pre-existing accounts of natural persons a reporting financial institution must apply the procedures of Annex I, Section III, part B of the Directive on administrative cooperation in taxation to lower-value accounts and those of part C to high-value accounts, those above the euro equivalent of USD 1,000,000, including an account that becomes high-value at the end of a later year, by 31 December of the following year. When a change in circumstances suggests the holder's tax residence may have changed, it must obtain a current self-certification or a reasonable explanation, and it may rely on the earlier residence for 90 days.

payload.refLabel: art. 4 lid 1 tot en met 5 en art. 2 lid 1

obligations.title: Add the duty: Determine whether entity accounts and their controlling persons are reportable
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Uitvoeringsbesluit identificatie- en rapportagevoorschriften Common Reporting Standard, BWBR0037469, art. 6 lid 1 tot en met 4 en art. 7, text in force from 2025-12-12; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0037469&artikel=6

titles.en: Determine whether entity accounts and their controlling persons are reportable

summaries.en: A reporting financial institution must apply the Directive's procedures for pre-existing and new entity accounts to determine whether the entity or, for a passive NFE, its beneficial owners are reportable persons, and must treat a holder of a pre-existing account as a passive NFE if it cannot establish whether it is an active NFE, a passive NFE or a financial institution. It may leave pre-existing entity accounts of at most the euro equivalent of USD 250,000 at 31 December 2015 unreviewed until they exceed that amount, and when a change in circumstances makes the documentation unreliable it must repeat the procedures by the end of the year or within 90 days, whichever is later.

payload.refLabel: art. 6 lid 1 tot en met 4 en art. 7

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not rely on a self-certification or evidence known or suspected to be wrong
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Uitvoeringsbesluit identificatie- en rapportagevoorschriften Common Reporting Standard, BWBR0037469, art. 9 lid 2, text in force from 2025-12-12; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0037469&artikel=9

titles.en: Do not rely on a self-certification or evidence known or suspected to be wrong

summaries.en: A reporting financial institution may not rely on a self-certification or documentary evidence if it knows or has reason to know that it is incorrect or unreliable.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Record the due diligence steps and evidence and keep them for at least seven years
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Uitvoeringsbesluit identificatie- en rapportagevoorschriften Common Reporting Standard, BWBR0037469, art. 9 lid 5, text in force from 2025-12-12; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0037469&artikel=9

titles.en: Record the due diligence steps and evidence and keep them for at least seven years

summaries.en: A reporting financial institution must record the steps it took and the evidence it relied on in carrying out the identification and reporting rules, keep that record and the evidence for at least seven years but no longer than necessary, and give the Minister of Finance access to them on request, within the period and in the manner the Minister sets.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Deliver the CRS data in the prescribed way by 31 January of the following year
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Uitvoeringsbesluit identificatie- en rapportagevoorschriften Common Reporting Standard, BWBR0037469, art. 10, text in force from 2025-12-12; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0037469&artikel=10

titles.en: Deliver the CRS data in the prescribed way by 31 January of the following year

summaries.en: A reporting financial institution must supply the data and information the act requires in the manner the Minister of Finance prescribes, by 31 January of the year after the calendar year they relate to or, where it reports over another period, after the calendar year in which that period ends; the Minister may allow another date.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Identify US reportable accounts with the procedures of the FATCA agreement
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Uitvoeringsbesluit internationale bijstandsverlening bij de heffing van belastingen, BWBR0030973, art. 2a lid 1, 4 en 5, text in force from 2021-01-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0030973&artikel=2a

titles.en: Identify US reportable accounts with the procedures of the FATCA agreement

summaries.en: A Dutch financial institution within the meaning of the FATCA agreement between the Netherlands and the United States, other than a non-reporting one, must follow the procedures in Annex I of that agreement to identify US reportable accounts. It may rely on procedures carried out by third parties, or apply the corresponding procedures of the US Treasury regulations instead, as far as the agreement allows.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report the data the FATCA agreement lists on each US reportable account
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Uitvoeringsbesluit internationale bijstandsverlening bij de heffing van belastingen, BWBR0030973, art. 2a lid 1 en 2, text in force from 2021-01-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0030973&artikel=2a

titles.en: Report the data the FATCA agreement lists on each US reportable account

summaries.en: Such an institution must supply the data and information listed in Article 2(2)(a)(1) to (7) of the FATCA agreement on each US reportable account, determined in line with Article 3(1) and (2) and Annexes I and II of the agreement.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Deliver the data in the prescribed manner and frequency and by the set deadline
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Uitvoeringsbesluit internationale bijstandsverlening bij de heffing van belastingen, BWBR0030973, art. 3, text in force from 2021-01-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0030973&artikel=3

titles.en: Deliver the data in the prescribed manner and frequency and by the set deadline

summaries.en: The banks, fund managers, investment funds, investment firms, payment service providers, e-money institutions, insurers and other institutions designated in arts. 2 and 2a must supply their data in the manner and at the frequency the Minister of Finance prescribes: for monthly delivery by the last day of the following month, for annual delivery during the year by 30 April of that year, and for annual delivery after the year by 31 January of the following year.

obligations.title: Add the duty: File a reportable cross-border arrangement within 30 days and each quarterly report within 30 days of the quarter's end
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Uitvoeringsbesluit internationale bijstandsverlening bij de heffing van belastingen, BWBR0030973, art. 3b lid 1 tot en met 5, text in force from 2021-01-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0030973&artikel=3b

titles.en: File a reportable cross-border arrangement within 30 days and each quarterly report within 30 days of the quarter's end

summaries.en: An intermediary, or a relevant taxpayer where no intermediary has to report, must file the data on a reportable cross-border arrangement in the manner the Minister of Finance prescribes within 30 days from the day after it was made available or ready for implementation or from the first step of implementation, whichever comes first; an intermediary that gave aid, assistance or advice on it files within 30 days of doing so. An intermediary files the periodic report on marketable arrangements within 30 days after the end of each quarter.

instruments.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Uitvoeringsbesluit inkomstenbelasting 2001, BWBR0012066, royal decree made under the Wet inkomstenbelasting 2001, whose arts. 2.5 to 10.9, among them 10.8, its preamble names; first published in Stb. 2000, 641; consolidated text in force from 2026-01-01, read in its XML file; entry into force on 2001-01-01 read in its own art. 26

obligations.title: Add the duty: Supply the tax administration each year with clients' balances, interest and investment income
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Uitvoeringsbesluit inkomstenbelasting 2001, BWBR0012066, art. 22 lid 1, 2 onder a, 3 en 5, text in force from 2026-01-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0012066&artikel=22

titles.en: Supply the tax administration each year with clients' balances, interest and investment income

summaries.en: Banks, investment firms, investment funds and their managers, payment service providers, e-money institutions, insurers and the other institutions the article lists must supply, for payment, savings and investment products, the value at the start of the calendar year, the interest received, the dividend income, the bond interest and the Dutch dividend tax and foreign withholding tax charged, each with the taxpayer's name, address and date of birth. They deliver in the manner and at the frequency the tax inspector prescribes: for monthly delivery by the end of the following month, for annual delivery during the year by 30 April, and for annual delivery after the year by 31 January of the following year.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Supply the tax administration each year with data on clients' home loans
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Uitvoeringsbesluit inkomstenbelasting 2001, BWBR0012066, art. 22 lid 2 onder b en c, 3 en 5, text in force from 2026-01-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0012066&artikel=22

titles.en: Supply the tax administration each year with data on clients' home loans

summaries.en: For home-ownership debts under art. 3.119a of the Income Tax Act 2001 the designated institutions must supply the value at the end of the year, the interest paid, the date the debt was entered into, its starting amount, the monthly interest rate at the end of the year and the remaining maximum term in months, and for the older home loans and other debts the article names the value at the end of the year and the interest paid. Each item goes with the taxpayer's name, address and date of birth and is delivered by the deadlines that apply to the account data.

instruments.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit toezicht trustkantoren 2018, BWBR0041680, royal decree made under arts. 1, 10, 14, 15, 16, 18, 30a and 49 of the Wet toezicht trustkantoren 2018 (preamble); first published in Stb. 2018, 463; consolidated text in force from 2024-07-01, read in its XML file; entry into force on 2019-01-01 read in the royal decree in Stb. 2018, 464 (Officiële bekendmakingen)

titles.nl: Besluit van 3 december 2018, houdende regels met betrekking tot onder meer een aanvullende trustdienst en nadere regels over de beoordeling van de betrouwbaarheid van beleidsbepalers, de integere en beheerste bedrijfsuitoefening, de compliance- en auditfunctie en uitbesteding door trustkantoren (Besluit toezicht trustkantoren 2018)
titles.en: Trust Offices Supervision Decree 2018

obligations.title: Add the duty: Analyse integrity risks systematically and update the analysis periodically
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit toezicht trustkantoren 2018, BWBR0041680, art. 10, text in force from 2024-07-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0041680&artikel=10

titles.en: Analyse integrity risks systematically and update the analysis periodically

summaries.en: A trust office must carry out a systematic analysis of its integrity risks and update it periodically, translate its integrity policy into procedures and measures known to all relevant units, carry them out, test and adjust them, have their execution monitored independently with shortcomings reported to the compliance function, and ensure that the shortcomings found lead to appropriate adjustment.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Counter the entanglement of private interests of policymakers, directors and staff
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit toezicht trustkantoren 2018, BWBR0041680, art. 11, text in force from 2024-07-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0041680&artikel=11

titles.en: Counter the entanglement of private interests of policymakers, directors and staff

summaries.en: A trust office must have procedures and measures to counter the entanglement of the private interests of its policymakers, its directors and those of group companies, the persons performing its compliance or audit function or sitting on its supervisory body, and other staff whose task or position could reasonably give rise to conflicts of interest.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Designate integrity-sensitive positions and screen everyone appointed to them
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit toezicht trustkantoren 2018, BWBR0041680, art. 12 en art. 13 lid 1 tot en met 3, text in force from 2024-07-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0041680&artikel=12

titles.en: Designate integrity-sensitive positions and screen everyone appointed to them

summaries.en: A trust office must distinguish integrity-sensitive from other positions using objective and knowable criteria, and make a reasoned assessment of the reliability of anyone it wants to appoint to such a position, checking identity, the data and references given and the person's fitness for the position. It must also assess the reliability of those who work in such a position other than under an employment contract, and keep records showing that this was done for every staff member or third party working for it.

payload.refLabel: art. 12 en art. 13 lid 1 tot en met 3

obligations.title: Add the duty: Classify clients, products and services by risk and detect unusual transaction patterns
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit toezicht trustkantoren 2018, BWBR0041680, art. 14 lid 1 en 2, text in force from 2024-07-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0041680&artikel=14

titles.en: Classify clients, products and services by risk and detect unusual transaction patterns

summaries.en: A trust office must have organisational and administrative procedures and measures for classifying clients, products and services by risk, and procedures and measures for analysing client data, also in relation to the products and services the client takes, and for detecting unusual transaction patterns.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep a current procedure manual covering compliance, audit, incidents and the anti-money laundering and sanctions acts
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit toezicht trustkantoren 2018, BWBR0041680, art. 16, text in force from 2024-07-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0041680&artikel=16

titles.en: Keep a current procedure manual covering compliance, audit, incidents and the anti-money laundering and sanctions acts

summaries.en: A trust office must keep an up-to-date procedure manual with procedures for complying with the act, covering at least the compliance and audit functions, the handling and recording of incidents, segregation of duties and integrity-sensitive positions, and with procedures for complying with the anti-money laundering act and the Sanctions Act 1977.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give the compliance function the means it needs, an annual risk-based work programme and a documented size
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit toezicht trustkantoren 2018, BWBR0041680, art. 17 lid 1 tot en met 5, text in force from 2024-07-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0041680&artikel=17

titles.en: Give the compliance function the means it needs, an annual risk-based work programme and a documented size

summaries.en: The unit performing a trust office's compliance function must have the authority, resources, expertise and access to information to work independently and effectively, and must identify, analyse, assess, advise on, monitor and report on the risk of insufficient compliance permanently and systematically. It draws up an annual risk-based work programme covering at least the items the article lists, including monitoring the management of integrity risks, supervising compliance with the procedure manual and reporting periodically to the board, and the trust office records in writing, with reasons, how many hours the function takes given its clients, activities and integrity risks.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Have the audit function check at least once a year and keep compliance and audit separate from client work
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit toezicht trustkantoren 2018, BWBR0041680, art. 18 lid 1 en 2 en art. 19 lid 1 tot en met 5, text in force from 2024-07-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0041680&artikel=18

titles.en: Have the audit function check at least once a year and keep compliance and audit separate from client work

summaries.en: A trust office's audit function must carry out a check at least once a year and have the expertise and access to information it needs. The trust office must segregate duties so that staff working for clients take no part in the compliance or audit function, compliance staff take no part in the audit function and no policymaker takes part in either; both functions report their findings to the board, management responsibility for them lies with two different policymakers, and their reports are kept available to De Nederlandsche Bank for five years.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Put outsourcing in a written contract, oversee the provider and verify identities yourself
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit toezicht trustkantoren 2018, BWBR0041680, art. 20 lid 1 tot en met 3, text in force from 2024-07-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0041680&artikel=20

titles.en: Put outsourcing in a written contract, oversee the provider and verify identities yourself

summaries.en: A trust office that outsources work to a third party must record the agreement in writing and ensure that the third party complies with the act and the procedure manual, having adequate procedures, measures, expertise and information to assess the outsourced work. It must in all circumstances itself verify the identity of the persons to whom the work is outsourced.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Base the test income on the consumer's current fixed and lasting income
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Tijdelijke regeling hypothecair krediet, BWBR0032503, art. 2 lid 1, 2, 4 en 5, text in force from 2026-01-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0032503&artikel=2

titles.en: Base the test income on the consumer's current fixed and lasting income

summaries.en: A mortgage lender must base the test income on the consumer's current fixed and lasting income; where income is not fixed it may use the average over the last three calendar years or 36 months, and it may also count expected income from freely available assets and an expected structural rise in income within a reasonable period. If the consumer reaches state pension age within ten years after taking out the loan, the lender must also take account of the expected income at that age.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep the mortgage's financing costs within the limit set by the income tables
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Tijdelijke regeling hypothecair krediet, BWBR0032503, art. 3 lid 1, 2, 5, 9, 10 en 12, text in force from 2026-01-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0032503&artikel=3

titles.en: Keep the mortgage's financing costs within the limit set by the income tables

summaries.en: The financing costs of a mortgage loan, calculated as the gross annual interest and repayment on a 30-year annuity or over the shorter term, may not exceed the permitted financing costs, which the lender derives from the consumer's test income and the financing cost percentage in Annex 1. For loans with a fixed-rate period shorter than ten years it uses the higher of the offered rate and the average rate the Authority for the Financial Markets publishes each quarter, which is at least 5 per cent, and it adds the consumer's other financial obligations to the financing costs or deducts them from the permitted financing costs.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Count the consumer's student loan instalments among the other financial obligations
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Tijdelijke regeling hypothecair krediet, BWBR0032503, art. 3a lid 1 tot en met 3, text in force from 2026-01-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0032503&artikel=3a

titles.en: Count the consumer's student loan instalments among the other financial obligations

summaries.en: In counting other financial obligations, a mortgage lender must take account of the instalment for interest and repayment of the consumer's student loan, grossed up by the factor in the table where the mortgage interest is wholly or partly tax deductible. Where no instalment or only a reduced one is due, it bases the instalment on the current outstanding debt, interest rate and remaining term of the student loan.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Exceed the financing cost limit only on a documented and verified case
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Tijdelijke regeling hypothecair krediet, BWBR0032503, art. 4 lid 1, text in force from 2026-01-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0032503&artikel=4

titles.en: Exceed the financing cost limit only on a documented and verified case

summaries.en: A mortgage lender may exceed the permitted financing costs only if the test income and financing costs were determined under the regulation, the reasons are recorded and supported by documents and calculations that test the case against the regulation's norms and explain why the loan is responsible in that situation, the lender can show that it checked the underlying data, and it has demonstrably assessed that the reason for the deviation is lasting.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Lend no more than 100 per cent of the home's value
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Tijdelijke regeling hypothecair krediet, BWBR0032503, art. 5 lid 1 tot en met 4, text in force from 2026-01-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0032503&artikel=5

titles.en: Lend no more than 100 per cent of the home's value

summaries.en: A mortgage loan may not exceed 100 per cent of the value of the home. A lender may go up to 106 per cent to finance energy-saving measures in the home, and the article lists further exceptions, such as a residual debt from selling a previous home and refinancing on the same property while the consumer keeps living there.

titles.en: Verify a natural person's identity on one of the designated documents

summaries.en: The documents designated for verifying the identity of a client, settlor, trustee or partner who is a natural person are a valid passport, a valid Dutch identity card, a valid identity card or driving licence issued by another member state with a photograph and the holder's name, a valid Dutch driving licence, a travel document for refugees and aliens, an aliens document issued under the Aliens Act 2000, and a sufficiently reliable means of identification.

obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Uitvoeringsregeling Wet ter voorkoming van witwassen en financieren van terrorisme, BWBR0024275, art. 4 lid 2 en 3, text in force from 2026-01-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0024275&artikel=4

titles.en: Verify a legal person's identity on the designated documents or from a reliable independent source

summaries.en: For a client that is a legal person incorporated under Dutch law with its seat in the Netherlands or a foreign legal person established in the Netherlands, the designated documents are an extract from the commercial register, a deed or statement by a lawyer, notary or comparable independent legal professional established in the Netherlands or another member state, and, for a church or an independent part of one, the documents the article names. The identity of a client not covered by the act's rules for natural and legal persons may be verified on documents, data or information from a reliable and independent source.

obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Regeling toezicht trustkantoren 2018, BWBR0041629, art. 8 lid 1 en 2, text in force from 2025-11-25; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0041629&artikel=8

titles.en: Supply the listed data when applying for a trust office licence

summaries.en: An applicant for a trust office licence must supply at least the identity and antecedents of its directors and supervisory board members, of those who determine or co-determine its policy and of the holders of qualifying holdings with their size, the formal and actual control structure of its group, its name, address and seat and those of its branches, its planned operations including the measures for integrity and its administrative organisation and internal control, and any other data the supervisor needs. Antecedents already assessed under the Financial Supervision Act may be replaced by a reference to that assessment.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Include the required details in every incident report to De Nederlandsche Bank
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Regeling toezicht trustkantoren 2018, BWBR0041629, art. 9, text in force from 2025-11-25; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0041629&artikel=9

titles.en: Include the required details in every incident report to De Nederlandsche Bank

summaries.en: When a trust office reports an incident under art. 20 of the Trust Offices Supervision Act 2018 it must state at least the persons involved, the object companies, conduit companies and beneficial owners concerned with a structure chart of the group, the period and a description of the incident and its integrity risks, what prompted the report with any public sources, the measures taken and the date by which they will be carried out, whether and why the Financial Intelligence Unit has been or will be informed, whether earlier transactions need to be reassessed or reported, and any other data the supervisor needs.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Ensure staff who inform or advise clients on investments have the required knowledge and competence
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Regeling vakbekwaamheid werknemers beleggingsondernemingen Wft, BWBR0040497, art. 2 lid 1 en 2, text in force from 2017-01-05; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0040497&artikel=2

titles.en: Ensure staff who inform or advise clients on investments have the required knowledge and competence

summaries.en: An investment firm must ensure that staff who inform clients about financial instruments, structured deposits, investment services or ancillary services, or who advise clients on financial instruments or structured deposits, know the main features, risks and costs of the products offered, the total costs for the client, the services provided, how markets work and how economic figures and events affect them, the difference between past performance and future scenarios, the outlines of the Market Abuse Regulation and the anti-money laundering act, the relevant product information, trading venues and valuation methods. Staff who advise must also have basic knowledge of individual portfolio management and be able to assess whether a product suits a client.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Let staff without the required competence inform or advise only under supervision and for at most four years
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Regeling vakbekwaamheid werknemers beleggingsondernemingen Wft, BWBR0040497, art. 2 lid 3, text in force from 2017-01-05; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0040497&artikel=2

titles.en: Let staff without the required competence inform or advise only under supervision and for at most four years

summaries.en: A staff member who lacks the required knowledge and competence may inform or advise clients only under the supervision of a qualified colleague who has the skills and resources to supervise and bears responsibility for the information or advice given, and for no longer than four years.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Evaluate the competence and training needs of these staff every year
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Regeling vakbekwaamheid werknemers beleggingsondernemingen Wft, BWBR0040497, art. 3, text in force from 2017-01-05; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0040497&artikel=3

titles.en: Evaluate the competence and training needs of these staff every year

summaries.en: An investment firm must evaluate every year the competence and training needs of the staff who inform or advise clients on financial instruments, structured deposits and investment services.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Build compliance with the sanctions rules into the administrative organisation and internal controls, including screening relations
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Regeling toezicht Sanctiewet 1977, BWBR0018806, art. 2 lid 1 en 2, text in force from 2014-05-09; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0018806&artikel=2

titles.en: Build compliance with the sanctions rules into the administrative organisation and internal controls, including screening relations

summaries.en: A financial institution under the Sanctions Act 1977 must ensure that its administrative organisation and internal controls include measures to comply with the sanctions rules on financial transactions. The measures cover at least an adequate check of its records for any match between the identity of a relation, meaning anyone involved in a financial service or transaction, and a person or entity named in the sanctions rules, so that the relation's funds can be frozen or no funds or services are made available to it.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report a match with a sanctioned person or entity to the supervisor without delay
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Regeling toezicht Sanctiewet 1977, BWBR0018806, art. 3, text in force from 2014-05-09; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0018806&artikel=3

titles.en: Report a match with a sanctioned person or entity to the supervisor without delay

summaries.en: When an institution finds that a relation's identity matches a person or entity named in the sanctions rules, it must report this without delay to its supervisor, the Authority for the Financial Markets or De Nederlandsche Bank as far as each supervises compliance with the act's financial rules, and hand over the relation's identity data with the report.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep sanctions match reports and the related account and transaction data until five years after the listing ends
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Regeling toezicht Sanctiewet 1977, BWBR0018806, art. 4, text in force from 2014-05-09; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0018806&artikel=4

titles.en: Keep sanctions match reports and the related account and transaction data until five years after the listing ends

summaries.en: An institution must keep the reports of matches, together with the data on the accounts of and transactions with the relations concerned, until five years after the sanctions rule naming the person or entity has ceased to have effect or has been suspended.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give the supervisor data on how the regulation is applied when asked
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Regeling toezicht Sanctiewet 1977, BWBR0018806, art. 5, text in force from 2014-05-09; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0018806&artikel=5

obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Regeling specifieke bepalingen CRD en CRR, BWBR0042578, art. 3:1 en art. 1:2 lid 2, text in force from 2026-03-06; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0042578&artikel=3:1

titles.en: Apply a 1,250 per cent risk weight to qualifying holdings outside the financial sector above the limits

summaries.en: A bank with its seat in the Netherlands that is not a significant credit institution under the SSM Regulation, or an investment firm under the CRR, must apply a risk weight of 1,250 per cent, when calculating its capital requirements under Part Three of the CRR, to the higher of the amount of qualifying holdings in undertakings outside the financial sector referred to in Article 89(1) of the CRR exceeding 15 per cent of its eligible capital and the total amount of such holdings referred to in Article 89(2) exceeding 60 per cent of its eligible capital.

obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Regeling specifieke bepalingen CRD en CRR, BWBR0042578, art. 3:2 en art. 3:3 lid 1 tot en met 3, text in force from 2026-03-06; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0042578&artikel=3:2

titles.en: Count a debtor as in default after 90 days past due on a material amount

summaries.en: Such an institution must apply the 90 days past due criterion for the exposure classes of Article 178(1)(b) of the CRR and assess the materiality of a past-due credit obligation against a two-part threshold: 100 euros for retail exposures and 500 euros for other exposures, and 1 per cent of the debtor's total on-balance sheet exposures to the institution and its group, excluding equity exposures. A default occurs when both limits are exceeded for 90 consecutive days, at the level of the credit line where the institution applies the default definition per facility for retail exposures.

titles.en: Apply a compliant remuneration policy to all staff whose work materially affects the risk profile

summaries.en: As part of its controlled business operations a bank or an investment firm under the CRR must pursue a remuneration policy meeting Annex A, including salaries and discretionary pension benefits, for the categories of staff whose professional activities have a material impact on its risk profile, and ensure that the undertakings referred to in Article 109(2) of the Capital Requirements Directive do the same. Those staff include at least all members of the management body and senior management, staff with managerial responsibility for control functions or material business units, and staff who in the previous year earned at least 500,000 euros and at least the average pay of the management body and senior management while working in a material business unit with a significant impact on its risk profile.

titles.en: Have the supervisory function adopt and oversee the remuneration principles and review the policy independently each year

summaries.en: The management body in its supervisory function adopts the general principles of the remuneration policy, reviews them periodically and oversees their implementation, and the implementation is subject at least once a year to a central and independent internal review. Staff in control functions are independent of the units they oversee and paid according to the objectives of their function, not the results of those units, and the remuneration committee, or failing one the supervisory function, directly oversees the pay of senior officers in risk management and compliance.

titles.en: Pay at least half of variable remuneration in shares or equivalent instruments subject to retention

summaries.en: A substantial part, and in any case at least 50 per cent, of variable remuneration must consist of a balance of shares or equivalent ownership interests or share-linked instruments and, where possible, instruments referred to in Article 52 or 63 of the CRR or other instruments that can be fully converted into Common Equity Tier 1 or written down, subject to an appropriate retention policy. This applies both to the deferred and to the non-deferred part.

titles.en: Defer at least 40 per cent of variable remuneration over four to five years

summaries.en: A substantial part, and in any case at least 40 per cent, of variable remuneration must be deferred over at least four to five years, at least five years for members of the management body and senior management of significant institutions, and at least 60 per cent where the variable amount is particularly high; deferred pay vests no faster than pro rata. These rules and the 50 per cent rule do not apply to an institution that is not large and whose assets averaged 5 billion euros or less over the previous four years, or to staff whose annual variable pay is at most 50,000 euros and at most one tenth of their total annual pay.

titles.en: Pay or vest variable remuneration only where the firm's financial situation and performance justify it

summaries.en: Variable remuneration, including the deferred part, is paid or vests only if it is sustainable given the financial situation of the bank or investment firm as a whole and justified by the performance of the firm, the business unit and the individual. Total variable remuneration is generally reduced considerably where the firm's financial performance is subdued or negative, both in current pay and through malus or clawback of amounts earned earlier.

titles.en: Set up a remuneration committee of non-executive members in a significant institution

summaries.en: A bank or investment firm that is significant in size, internal organisation and the nature, scope and complexity of its activities must set up a remuneration committee composed so that it can judge the remuneration policy and its incentives for managing risk, capital and liquidity competently and independently. The committee prepares the remuneration decisions the management body takes, weighing the long-term interests of shareholders, investors and other stakeholders and the public interest, and its chair and members are members of the management body without executive functions in the firm.

summaries.en: A bank, payment institution or e-money institution with its seat in the Netherlands that carries out 120 million or more giro retail transactions a year must have a sound, clear and enforceable legal basis for its activities in every relevant jurisdiction, ensure compliance with it and keep its agreements unambiguous, and have a clear, balanced and adequate governance structure that takes account of the public interest in well-functioning retail payments. Tasks and responsibilities for retail payments and the standards applied, including those for availability and security, must be assigned unambiguously and at a sufficiently senior level.

titles.en: Manage the operational risks of retail payments with systems that ensure high availability and security

titles.en: Put the prescribed risk warning with the firm's own loss percentage in every CFD communication

summaries.en: Any communication to retail clients, or information accessible to them, about CFDs must carry the risk warning specified in Annex II, given a prominent place, in the same language and at least the dominant font size, and stating a current provider-specific percentage of retail CFD accounts that lost money, recalculated every three months over the preceding twelve months with all costs included.

titles.en: Take no part in activities that circumvent the CFD restrictions

summaries.en: No one may knowingly take part in activities whose object or effect is to circumvent the conditions of art. 2, including by acting as a substitute for the CFD provider.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Quote no ask price for a turbo whose leverage exceeds the maximum for its underlying
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit beperkingen aan turbo’s, BWBR0045359, art. 2, onderdeel 1, en bijlage I, text in force from 2021-10-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0045359&artikel=2

titles.en: Quote no ask price for a turbo whose leverage exceeds the maximum for its underlying

summaries.en: A turbo provider may market, distribute or sell turbos to retail clients in the Netherlands only if it quotes no ask price for a turbo whose leverage exceeds the maximum leverage set in Annex I, which runs from 30 for major currency pairs to 2 for cryptocurrencies and 5 for shares and underlyings not otherwise listed.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give retail clients no payment or benefit for trading turbos
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit beperkingen aan turbo’s, BWBR0045359, art. 2, onderdeel 2, text in force from 2021-10-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0045359&artikel=2

titles.en: Give retail clients no payment or benefit for trading turbos

summaries.en: The turbo provider may not give a retail client, directly or indirectly, any payment, monetary benefit or non-monetary benefit, other than information and research tools relating to turbos, in connection with marketing, distributing or selling a turbo, apart from the price of a turbo the client sells or the payment of residual value on settlement.

titles.en: Put the prescribed risk warning with the firm's own loss percentage in every turbo communication

summaries.en: Any communication to retail clients, or information accessible to them, about turbos must carry the risk warning specified in Annex II, given a prominent place, in the same language and at least the dominant font size, and stating a current provider-specific percentage of retail clients who lost money trading turbos with the provider, recalculated every three months over the preceding twelve months with all costs included.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report another provider's breach of the leverage limit and take no part in circumventing the restrictions
obligations.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit beperkingen aan turbo’s, BWBR0045359, art. 3 lid 1 en 2, text in force from 2021-10-01; the article's address on wetten.overheid.nl is jci1.3:c:BWBR0045359&artikel=3

titles.en: Report another provider's breach of the leverage limit and take no part in circumventing the restrictions

summaries.en: No one may knowingly take part in activities that circumvent the conditions of art. 2 or act as a substitute for the turbo provider to that end. A provider of a specific turbo that finds that another provider of the same turbo does not comply with the leverage limit must report this as soon as possible to that provider and to the competent authority.
